description.narrative: This project aims to "Strengthen the resilience of poor and vulnerable populations affected by the security crisis and the effects of climate change in Burkina Faso" through the following specific objective The living conditions of vulnerable local populations in 14 communes in the Centre-North and Sahel regions are improved.To achieve this, a theory of change (ToC) is built around approaches that will allow the consortium to: (i) Restore livelihoods through non-productive and productive social safety net activities. This will mainly involve the distribution of small ruminants, village poultry farming, distribution of agropastoral inputs and unconditional cash to vulnerable households. It will also aim to protect livelihoods through the strengthening of productive capacities thanks to the development of agropastoral areas, the recovery of degraded land and the inclusion of climate scenarios in the Communal Development Plans (CDP) and the distribution of agropastoral inputs. These actions will contribute to the strengthening and protection of livelihoods and also to the productive capacities of vulnerable households, including displaced persons.(ii) On the other hand, the use of productive social nets to protect livelihoods as well as labor-intensive work (HIMO), which will be carried out in collaboration with the communes, will be a source of financial resources to strengthen the financial capacities of targets. These HIMO activities constitute temporary rural employment opportunities for IDPs and communities. The beneficiaries of these activities (labour-based and productive social nets) will be organized upstream and downstream of the activities to enable them to make good use of the resources they receive. The adoption of this strategy will lead them to strengthen their financial capacities in the medium term and to insert themselves into local economic circuits.(iii) In addition, the consortium will work in collaboration with the communes for the emergence and revitalization of functional quality communal social services through support for the provision of quality human and material resources. This prerequisite will make it possible to have a good single social register of the vulnerability of people at the level of each commune, on which the consortium will rely to operationalize the non-productive social nets for the benefit of vulnerable people in order to strengthen social protection for vulnerable households and people with low production capacity at the level of their respective communes. In view of the context, particular emphasis will be placed on conflict sensitivity through the "Do no harm" approach for the prevention of conflicts related to the implementation of project activities..
